sql:
SELECT
    s.StoreKey,
    s.StoreName,
    sum(f.SalesAmount) AS TotalSales,
    sum(f.SalesAmount) / nullif(countDistinct(f.SalesOrderNumber), 0) AS AvgOrderValue,
    countDistinct(f.SalesOrderNumber) AS NumberOfTransactions
FROM retail.FactOnlineSales f
JOIN retail.DimStore s ON f.StoreKey = s.StoreKey
GROUP BY s.StoreKey, s.StoreName
ORDER BY TotalSales DESC
